objective: Find Sensei Hisame in the Academy yard at dusk
title: The Night Before
summary: Hisame tells you what the academy keeps in its vault, and Asahi comes to watch.

say: So this is the new genin. Tobi. I teach the first-years to throw things at targets instead of each other.
And he fails at it every spring.
Every spring they get better at hitting each other. That's a kind of progress.

lines: Sit with us a moment, {name}. A genin should know what the academy is guarding.
What's in it. The Scroll of Five Natures. The founders wrote it when these islands were still at war with each other.
Fire, wind, lightning, earth, water. Five natures, five seals. It can lend its chakra to make clones, which is why we train with it.
And it's older than the academy. Older than the walls. Some of the seals in it nobody here can read any more.
Because the founders made us promise to. And because whatever they sealed is safer with us than with anyone else.
Enough history. You've had a long day, and you'll have a longer one tomorrow.
Show me you can still move. Two dashes, then gather your chakra.
Good. Tired, but good. That's the right way round.
I wasn't watching. I was walking past. Very slowly.
Asahi. Your patrol route doesn't come through the yard.
He's been on the wall since your trial, {name}. He thinks nobody saw.
...I wanted to see who I'm fighting. That's all.
And my mother was the best lightning user this academy ever trained. Everybody says so. So I have to be better than everybody.
Noon. Don't make me wait. I'm bad at waiting.
He's not as loud as he sounds. Most of it is for himself.
